oldGuards.failure: test_cmppatch_real_human_acceptance_preserves_raw_findings expects historical execution approval as current; applicability_active_plan correctly rejects. Old tests unchanged; new test proves historical acceptance and current refusal separately.

bandit.assessment: B404/B603: no-shell subprocess with static argv policy and private output; B105 token endpoint URL is not a credential. Raw findings retained, not suppressed.

verification.productCoverage: NOT RUN; neither 80% gate passed or reduced

governance.meaning: Governance checks only; do not override old-suite failure, image findings or missing product/runtime verification.

resources.limits: Monitoring is not a hard quota; Docker total memory is not available VM memory. Run limit 40GiB within original 80GiB; no runtime start or budget reset.

cleanup.retention_reason: Retain verified public artifacts, raw scans, signature failures/successes, source metadata and test reports for reproducibility; no shared cache or prior evidence removed.
